description.value: Starbucks is the world's largest coffeehouse chain, tracing its origins to Seattle's Pike Place Market in 1971 and now operating tens of thousands of locations globally. This North Vancouver location (unit 21) is part of that network, offering the brand's full range of espresso drinks, teas, refreshers, and food items. Touring cyclists across BC will recognize Starbucks as a consistent waypoint along busy urban and suburban corridors.
